## Core Architectural Philosophies
1. **Inside Out (Mereduksi Batas Ruang Dalam & Luar)**: Dissolving boundaries between indoor and outdoor living through double-height voids, passive thermal cross-ventilation, and coastal aluminum louvers engineered for Surabaya's tropical climate.
2. **Balanced Contrast (Harmoni Tekstur Kasar & Halus)**: Uniting raw monolithic structural concrete (ReadyMix SNI K-350) and black structural steel with honed Italian Statuario marble, travertine, and solid Javanese teakwood with joint deviance strictly under 1mm.
3. **Narrative Space (Ruang Spasial yang Mengalir & Bercerita)**: Purpose-driven spatial sequencing with pre-cast embedded MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) conduits, eliminating any destructive retrofitting post-pour.

## Physical Engineering Provenance & Technical Standards
- **Structural Concrete Standard**: Ready-Mix SNI K-350 with mandatory onsite slump test verification per mixer truck. Anti-seismic rebar tied with double bendrat wire; zero honeycomb tolerance.
- **Dimensional Precision**: 90° digital laser corner alignment with joint deviance strictly under 1mm for marble vein bookmatching and tile grout lines.
- **MEP Integration**: Embedded conduits and water piping integrated prior to concrete floor slab pours.
- **Contractual Transparency**: Legally certified construction contracts (SPK), open itemized volume Bills of Quantities (RAB/BOQ) with zero hidden fees, and transparent daily photographic dispatch.
- **Warranty & Retention**: Official 100-day post-handover retention guarantee backed by dedicated structural maintenance engineers, plus 5-year structural warranty.

## Key Projects Portfolio (Surabaya & East Java)
- **DG House**: Bespoke Custom Luxury Residence, Jakarta & Surabaya Timur. Double-height void, Statuario marble, ulin wood trellis.
- **MJ House**: Tropical Modern Estate, Cibubur & Surabaya Barat. Monolithic basalt, cantilever canopy, water mirror pool.
- **M House**: Minimalist Contemporary Residence, Surabaya. 4.2m void, custom facade louvers, teakwood joinery.
- **AW House**: Luxury Villa Sanctuary, Seminyak Bali & Surabaya. 25m linear pool, coastal marine-grade hardware.
- **W Office**: Commercial Headquarters, Surabaya. Double-glazed curtain wall for 42dB acoustic isolation, executive rooftop garden.
- **Jotun Showroom Flagship**: Commercial Flagship Fit-Out, Surabaya. High-CRI 97+ lighting, acoustic ceilings, museum-grade display alignment.
- **Puri Indah Residence**: Modern Minimalist Residence, Surabaya Barat. Rectilinear cantilevered volumes, hidden facade gutters.
- **RMB House**: Modern Classic Residence, Surabaya Timur. Botticino marble portal, subterranean 6-car garage, rooftop skyline pavilion.

## Permitting & Compliance Assistance
- Complete architectural drafting, civil structural calculations, and as-built drawings for **PBG** (Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung) and **SLF** (Sertifikat Laik Fungsi) with Dinas Cipta Karya Kota Surabaya, Pemkab Sidoarjo, and Gresik.
